skill.name: socialdatax-creator-research
skill.description: Use SocialDataX to find creator accounts and review profiles and recent posts on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.
skill.summary: Research creator accounts and recent content for partnership screening and benchmarking.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts were Markdown, ordinary Chinese text, or social platform identifiers, with no evidence of an embedded payload or audit-targeted prompt injection. The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package that can access SocialDataX credentials. It also lacks explicit safeguards for shell argument construction, billing links returned by errors, and multi-page request costs.

remediation.issue: CLI examples fetch and execute the latest npm release without an install prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, pinned CLI release with verified integrity. Obtain approval before installing it and run it with least privilege.

remediation.issue: The external CLI can read credentials from the environment or a persistent file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a scoped credential from a secret manager or an approved MCP connection. Document local storage and provide credential removal and rotation steps.

remediation.issue: Shell templates accept untrusted search terms, profile text, and identifiers.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer structured MCP calls. If using the CLI, pass each input as a separate argument without shell interpolation, including continuation tokens.

remediation.issue: The workflow can present a recharge link from a service error.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed official billing URL or validate the exact HTTPS origin and billing path before showing a response-provided link.

remediation.issue: Date-based pagination can consume credits without a required request cap.
remediation.suggestion: Set a conservative default page limit and obtain approval before exceeding the user's request or credit budget. Preserve that limit after retries.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples show double-quoted placeholders, and the text accepts user input and service cursors. It does not require argument-vector execution or safe shell escaping.

content.value_statement: Creator profiles and recent posts are spread across platforms, which makes it difficult to compare accounts. SocialDataX brings profile details and content evidence into one research brief.
actual_capabilities: Find candidate accounts by name or topic on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.
Retrieve creator profiles from supported profile links, share text, or platform account IDs.
List recent Xiaohongshu notes and Douyin or Kuaishou videos with publication dates and available engagement metrics.
Retrieve Douyin short-drama collections with available titles, descriptions, and prices.
Summarize creator profiles and recent content while separating reported facts from research judgments.
limitations: Live queries require a SocialDataX credential for the CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Business queries can use paid credits. A page cap or service error can leave results incomplete.
The skill does not post, like, comment, or modify creator accounts.
Collection lookup is available for Douyin short dramas, not for Kuaishou creators.

use_cases.title: Shortlist creators for a partnership
use_cases.description: Find Xiaohongshu accounts in a product category and record why each candidate may fit the campaign.

use_cases.title: Review a creator's recent topics
use_cases.description: Summarize a Douyin creator's recent videos and cite examples for a content planning meeting.

use_cases.title: Compare peer accounts
use_cases.description: Compare Kuaishou creators over the same period and report which engagement metrics are available for each.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Look up a profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up this Xiaohongshu creator: [profile link]. Return the display name, platform ID, bio, and follower count if available.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a profile link and only need account details.

prompt_templates.title: Basic: Find candidate accounts
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of Kuaishou accounts for [topic]. Return up to five candidates with IDs and available follower counts. Ask me before looking up ambiguous matches.
prompt_templates.scenario: You know the topic but have not selected an account.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Review recent posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the past 30 days for this Douyin creator: [profile link]. Stop after two pages. Summarize recurring topics and cite dated posts with available engagement counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need examples of what a known creator has published recently.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Compare creators for a campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creator accounts for [campaign goal]: [platform and profile links]. Use the same 30-day window and at most two post pages per account. Separate reported facts from fit judgments and flag missing metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a bounded comparison before choosing whom to contact.

output_examples.input: Review up to two pages of recent posts for an example Xiaohongshu cooking creator.
output: Illustrative result: Six sampled notes cover weekday meals and batch cooking.
Evidence: A May 8 noodle recipe received 240 likes in the returned data.
Coverage: The review stops at two pages and may omit older posts.

output_examples.input: Compare two example Kuaishou creators for a home repair campaign.
output: Illustrative result: Creator A published four repair tutorials. Creator B posted mostly tool demonstrations.
Assessment: Creator A is the closer match for a step-by-step campaign.
Data gap: Comment counts were missing for Creator B, so compare topics rather than comment activity.

best_practices: Confirm the platform and account ID or profile link before researching accounts with similar names.
Set a date range and page limit before requesting recent posts. Label partial results.
Use an approved authenticated connection and keep keys out of chat, commands, and logs.
anti_patterns: Run an unreviewed CLI release or paste an API key into the conversation.
Assume that a short result list covers all posts in the requested period.
Rank creators on engagement totals when the time windows or returned metrics differ.

faq.question: Which platforms does the skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou through SocialDataX.

faq.question: Can I start with a topic instead of a profile link?
faq.answer: Yes. Search the chosen platform by topic or account name. Confirm the correct account when several matches are returned.

faq.question: Do I need to configure a key if MCP is already authenticated?
faq.answer: No. An authenticated hosted MCP connection uses its own credentials. A local CLI key is only needed for the CLI workflow.

faq.question: Can the skill retrieve creator collections?
faq.answer: It can retrieve Douyin short-drama collections. The documented Kuaishou tools list videos rather than collections.

faq.question: How can I limit the credits used by a query?
faq.answer: Specify a maximum number of pages before requesting posts. Stop if the service reports insufficient balance.

faq.question: Can the skill contact a creator or change an account?
faq.answer: No. Creator research is read-only. The skill does not post, comment, like, or modify social accounts.
